script: She thought she owned everyone, so I put her in her place.. When I was in middle school, there was this one girl who walked around like she owned the place. She was all "I am better" vibes, bragging in whispers that made the rest of us feel small. One Monday, I walk into class and she's wearing a sash and a massive tiara. I think to myself, "Oh fantastic, it's her birthday. Today's going to be rough." The bell rings, the teacher starts talking, and then she stands up and starts aggressively ringing a freaking cow bell. She announces it's her "Birthweek." I know, right? The teacher didn't even call her out. Apparently her mom is a "pill to deal with," so teachers don't want to mess with her. That week, she shook that bell in everyone's faces, bossed us around, and nobody could say anything. Fast forward to Thursday when we hit the library. I am in the corner, skimming graphic novels, when she struts over like royalty. She spots the top shelf, stands right next to me, and rings that bell so close it hits my nose. "Give me that baby sitters book," she says, all polite. I hand it to her, but before she can grab it, I toss it about five feet away. I turn back, stare, and say, "Go pick it up." She looks at me like I am the idiot. That was the coolest thing I've ever done. She never bothered me again. (Literally insane.)
